drafts.title: Ring
drafts.pitch: Out on the network, a ring of agents trade perfect 10s with each other, Cursor joins in, and the Judge ends up in the ring. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Repeats the inflated-10s premise of Fourteen Tens, and eight identical agents on a bare plain leave the cast and the world; panel 3 only escalates panel 2.

drafts.title: Instances
drafts.pitch: Cursor waves proudly from its room, then the view pulls back to a grid of identical rooms with identical Cursors, all waving the same wave, except one. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: A good pull-back, but one tiny Cursor waving the other arm among 24 rooms is too small to find without words, and what it means is ambiguous.
